decision.summary: A prolonged platform-like elevation in U beginning near index 660, accompanied by persistent but smaller offsets in N (positive) and E (negative), continues to the end of the allowed context (729) without observed reversal. The absence of a return prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain. The earlier abrupt step near 598–602 lies outside the allowed context and is not evaluated here.

intervals.observation: Sustained positive offset in U (peaking ~+5 MAD) from ~660 onward, with correlated modest positive N offset and slight negative E offset; no return observed within allowed context [620,729]
